1.Nf3 e6 2.c4 a6 3.Nc3 c5 4.g3.strategy: Prepares the fianchetto so the bishop on g2 will aim at b7 and the queenside, exactly where Black's pawns are heading, once the f3 knight steps aside. White develops solidly and keeps the centre flexible.

1.Nf3 e6 2.c4 a6 3.Nc3 c5 4.g3 b5.strategy: A pawn sacrifice to open the a- and b-files and seize the initiative on the queenside. White takes the pawn and ends a pawn up, and Black's compensation is activity rather than anything concrete.
1.Nf3 e6 2.c4 a6 3.Nc3 c5 4.g3 b5.name: Zukertort Opening: Shabalov Gambit
